data.title: Package Manager
data.notes: Manage all your system packages, including reporting outdated packages and performing automatic upgrades.

tools.title: Outdated Packages
tools.description: Report all outdated packages, and optionally perform all necessary upgrades.

fields.title: Send Email
fields.caption: Send email containing information about all outdated packages.

fields.title: Perform Upgrades
fields.caption: Actually perform upgrades of all outdated packages to the latest releases.

fields.title: Email Addresses
fields.caption: Send email to these specific addresses (comma-separated).

tools.title: List All Packages
tools.description: Generate a list of all installed packages.

fields.title: Send Email
fields.caption: Send email containing information about all packages.

fields.title: Email Addresses
fields.caption: Send email to these specific addresses (comma-separated).

tools.title: Software Bill of Materials
tools.description: Generate a SBOM file and attach it to the job output.

fields.title: SBOM Format
fields.caption: Select which SBOM standard to follow.

fields.title: File Format
fields.caption: Select the desired file format for the SBOM.

fields.title: Vulnerability Lookup
fields.caption: Query OSV.dev for known vulnerabilities and include them in the SBOM where supported. This makes an external network request.

tools.title: Install Packages
tools.description: Install a specific set of packages.

fields.title: Package IDs
fields.caption: List of package IDs to install (optionally with @versions), comma-separated.

tools.title: Upgrade Packages
tools.description: Upgrade a specific set of packages.

fields.title: Package IDs
fields.caption: List of package IDs to upgrade (optionally with @versions), comma-separated.

tools.title: Remove Packages
tools.description: Remove a specific set of packages.

fields.title: Package IDs
fields.caption: List of package IDs to remove, comma-separated.

tools.title: Backup Packages
tools.description: Save the current state of all installed packages to a TOML file.

tools.title: Restore Packages
tools.description: Restore the state of all installed packages from an input TOML file.

tools.title: Combined Report
tools.description: Generate a single combined report from a multiplexed set of input reports.

fields.title: Send Email
fields.caption: Send email containing information about all packages.

fields.title: Email Addresses
fields.caption: Send email to these specific addresses (comma-separated).

params.title: MPM Launcher
params.caption: Select how to launch meta-package-manager. Use UVX if the standalone binary fails due to GLIBC compatibility issues.

params.title: Package Managers
params.caption: Select which package managers to enable and/or disable.
